Course

From zero to a chip: FPGA programming with t27

No hardware background needed. Every lesson opens a real tool built from real runs on our bench: read a little, then try it yourself.

27 lessons, one working widget and one t27 spec each: what an FPGA is, how numbers become bits, your own t27 spec, how t27c compiles it, and how it becomes a bitstream on a real board.

Open the interactive course → Whole course on one page →

Every course is free, for everyone: no sign-up, no email, nothing to pay.

TRI CLAW

The agent behind t27, in Telegram and on GitHub

TRI CLAW is the project's agent: it writes and checks .t27 specs with you. Three ways to use it.

  • Free, with your own key

    Add your own API key (NVIDIA or z.ai today) and the agent runs on it. Add more keys any time.

    Add a key in Telegram ↗

  • We do it for you

    No keys to keep: join the club in our Telegram bot and the agent runs on ours. The bot shows the price before you pay.

    Join the club in Telegram ↗

  • On GitHub

    TRI CLAW is also a GitHub App, built to check the .t27 specs a pull request changes. It is not open to other repositories yet.

    Read about TRI CLAW ↗

This course is itself a t27 spec: read it

Widgets keep their own English words: each one lives in its own t27 spec.
